subject: dym-f
title: (R)DYM.F.------PRI.INFO.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 349 (R(AS)CM(I)-33). DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; PRI-INFO (principle information) is the partner. From the subject: ALT-D (alternative definitions) and BIA (bi-aitional). From ALT-D: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From BIA: SOC-RT (social reality). From VT-DY: AFI-1 (affinity insight—first degree) and POST (postulation). From POST: INFO-DY (information dynamics) and EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From INFO-DY: RE-ST (restructuralism).
